articles.title: Elon Musk could become a top 5 corporate bitcoin holder if Tesla and SpaceX merge
articles.snippet: CNBC reported Tuesday that Musk is discussing a merger between Tesla and SpaceX that would tie his tech empire closer together and instantly create the world’s fifth-largest corporate bitcoin treasury, worth $3.3 billion.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: How the GENIUS Act repriced bitcoin's monetary premium
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Ravi Tanuku on why the GENIUS Act didn't just regulate stablecoins, it repriced Bitcoin's monetary premium. Then, Jesper Johansen on why looped ETH staking no longer needs a lending market.

articles.title: Robinhood is letting AI trade for you so you don't have to keep checking the markets
articles.snippet: Robinhood is bringing hedge fund-style automation to everyday investors by letting AI agents build portfolios, execute stock trades, and even go shopping using virtual credit cards.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Internet Computer (ICP) Jumps 9.8%
articles.snippet: Stellar (XLM), up 1.7%, joined Internet Computer (ICP) as a top performer.

articles.title: Solana DEX Orca launches new marketplace for tokenized real-world assets
articles.snippet: The launch comes as crypto companies increasingly focus on tokenizing traditional financial assets, a market many in the industry see as a major growth opportunity.
